clue.text: Obsequious type getting kick with spirits, say

parts.note: to kick is to boot

indicators.note: say signals that the word for spirits is only to be heard, not spelt

parts.note: spirits are strong drink, liquor

explanation.surface: A fawning flunkey gets a kick out of hard drink.
explanation.walkthrough: In British (non-rhotic) speech LIQUOR and LICKER are pronounced the same, so 'say' turns the drink into the person who licks.
explanation.definitionFit: A bootlicker is a toady who flatters superiors servilely.

clue.text: Tramp crossing river to a country out East

indicators.note: crossing here means lying across, so the tramp goes round the river

parts.note: a bum is a tramp, a vagrant

explanation.surface: A vagrant wades a river to reach a far eastern land.
explanation.definitionFit: Burma, now Myanmar, is a country in South-East Asia.

clue.text: Old way to suppress ethnic prejudice that increases Coventry's population

indicators.note: in a down clue, putting the first pieces on top of the last presses it down

parts.note: ST, street, is a way
racism is ethnic prejudice

explanation.surface: An ancient method of crushing racial bias makes more people suffer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sent to Coventry' is a British idiom for being shunned, so ostracism adds people to Coventry.
explanation.definitionFit: Ostracism is excluding someone from society, which the idiom calls sending them to Coventry.

clue.text: Farrar's alternative title gradually revealed

definitions.meaning: F. W. Farrar's Victorian school story is titled Eric, or ... with this phrase as its second title

explanation.surface: A Victorian novel's subtitle emerges slowly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revealed' is a link: the phrase comes out bit by bit.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means step by step, and is the subtitle of Farrar's novel Eric.

clue.text: Ruminant West Indian almost getting out

parts.note: a Carib is a native of the Caribbean islands

indicators.note: almost means not quite all, so the final letter is dropped

explanation.surface: A grazing West Indian nearly escapes.
explanation.definitionFit: The caribou is a North American reindeer, a cud-chewing animal.

clue.text: Composer, in set pieces, is solemn

indicators.note: in places the composer inside the scrambled letters
set broken into pieces is rearranged

parts.note: Thomas Arne was an English composer, of Rule, Britannia!

explanation.surface: A composer is serious about his set pieces.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set pieces' reads like a musical or theatrical term, but 'pieces' breaks up 'set' into EST, and the composer sits within.
explanation.definitionFit: Earnest means serious and sincere in manner.

clue.text: Marx, nonetheless, unwanted in party?

indicators.note: read as none-the-less: a nought, the ring-shaped letter, is taken away from the Marx brother

parts.note: Harpo was the silent

explanation.surface: A question of whether a Marx is still unwelcome among the comrades.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Marx' points the solver at Karl and politics, but it is Harpo Marx. The definition is playful: to harp, or harp on, is to drone on about one grievance, which nobody wants at a party.
explanation.definitionFit: Harping on, repeating one complaint tediously, is behaviour a party guest would not welcome.

clue.text: Spanish friend observed Russian fighter entering a ring

indicators.note: entering means going inside, so the plane goes into the other letters

parts.note: O is ring-shaped
a MiG is a Russian fighter plane

explanation.surface: A friend in Spain watched a Soviet jet fly into the ring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'observed' is a link: the friend is seen in the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Amigo is the Spanish word for a pal.

clue.text: Recipes revised extremely liberally-? Just so

indicators.note: revised means changed, so the letters of recipes are rearranged
extremely points to the first and last letters of liberally

explanation.surface: Cookbook recipes rewritten very freely, exactly.
explanation.walkthrough: RECIPES rearranged gives PRECISE; 'extremely' gives L and Y from 'liberally'.
explanation.definitionFit: Precisely is a reply meaning exactly, quite right.

clue.text: Management goes for temporary patching up

parts.note: running a business is managing it
to repair to a place is to go to it

explanation.surface: The bosses opt for a short-term fix.
explanation.walkthrough: 'repair to' is a formal phrase meaning go to.
explanation.definitionFit: Running repairs are quick fixes made while something stays in use.

clue.text: Revolutionary device going backwards and forwards

indicators.note: says the whole entry reads the same in either direction, a palindrome

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A gadget that spins by moving to and fro.
explanation.definitionFit: A rotator is a mechanism that turns round, i.e. revolves.

clue.text: Way to embrace during dance sequence

indicators.note: to embrace is to hold inside, so the word for way wraps round the next piece

parts.note: a route is a way
in can mean during, as in 'in the night'

explanation.surface: How to hold your partner while dancing a sequence.
explanation.definitionFit: A routine is a fixed set of steps performed by a dancer.

clue.text: Woman apt to switch starters on menu

parts.note: Ava is a woman's name

indicators.note: the first two letters of the word for apt change places, the opening letter moving one step along

parts.note: apt means liable, inclined

explanation.surface: A woman decides to swap the first courses on the menu.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Starters' suggests first courses; here it means opening letters: LIABLE becomes ILABLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Something on the menu is available, obtainable to order.

clue.text: The girl I grumble about

indicators.note: about here means turned round, so the two pieces are read backwards

parts.note: to grumble is to moan

explanation.surface: The girl I keep complaining about.
explanation.definitionFit: Naomi is a female first name, as for the biblical mother-in-law of Ruth.

clue.text: Conservative member's rise in social status

parts.note: a limb is a member of the body

explanation.surface: A Tory member of parliament moves up in the world.
explanation.walkthrough: 'member' suggests a club or parliament; it is an arm or leg.
explanation.definitionFit: A social climb is an ascent up the class ladder.

clue.text: Establish fixed scale as a politician, in case

indicators.note: in places the politician and article inside the box

parts.note: a crate is a packing case
LIB is short for a Liberal

explanation.surface: A politician packed in a box sets the scale.
explanation.definitionFit: To calibrate is to mark or set the graduations of an instrument against a standard.

clue.text: Powerless to protect a number impossible to defend

indicators.note: to protect is to surround, so the word for powerless goes round the number

parts.note: powerless means unable
ten is a number

explanation.surface: Helpless to shield one figure, the position cannot be held.
explanation.definitionFit: An untenable position cannot be maintained against attack.

clue.text: Dance around a top-class king with a stringed instrument

indicators.note: around means the dance surrounds the next letter

parts.note: a ball is a dance
A1, written AI, means top-class
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A dance circles a first-rate king with a stringed instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: A1, the top grade in old ship registers, is written AI in crosswords.
explanation.definitionFit: The balalaika is a triangular Russian lute-like instrument.

clue.text: Fruit easy to digest is the focus of attention

parts.note: a lime is a citrus fruit
light food is easy on the stomach

explanation.surface: A fruit that sits lightly on the stomach becomes the centre of attention.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in the limelight means being in the public eye, named after old stage lighting.

clue.text: News about city theologian makes us rejoice

definitions.note: a verb phrase with an object; the answer means make glad

indicators.note: about means around, so the news goes round the other pieces

parts.note: gen is slang for information, news
LA, Los Angeles, is a city
DD, Doctor of Divinity, is a theologian

explanation.surface: News about a city churchman makes us happy.
explanation.definitionFit: To gladden is to cheer someone up, making them happy.

clue.text: Artist occupying office in row of houses

indicators.note: occupying means filling, so the artist goes inside the office

parts.note: terce is one of the canonical hours, a church office said at the third hour
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A painter takes over an office in a street of houses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'office' suggests a workplace; it is a church service.
explanation.definitionFit: A terrace is a row of joined houses.

clue.text: Revive motoring competition

definitions.meaning: a road race for cars, often over public roads

explanation.surface: A motor race brought back to life.
explanation.definitionFit: Rally means both to recover and a long-distance driving event.

clue.text: Dogmatist's extensive collection of religious books

parts.note: extensive means big
OT is the Old Testament, a collection of books of the Bible

explanation.surface: A zealot owns a huge library of scripture.
explanation.definitionFit: A bigot holds opinions intolerantly, as a dogmatist does.

clue.text: Spirit, in general, that's in short supply

parts.note: i.e. is the abbreviation for 'that is'

explanation.surface: Ghosts are generally scarce.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in short supply' signals the abbreviations: both pieces are shortened forms.
explanation.definitionFit: A genie is a magical spirit, as in the jinn of Arabian tales.

clue.text: Citadel's produce raised in a poor soil

indicators.note: in places the harvest inside the other letters
poor signals the letters of soil are badly arranged

parts.note: a crop is produce that is grown, raised

explanation.surface: A fortress's harvest was grown in bad earth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' looks like a reversal signal but belongs with 'produce'; 'poor' makes OLIS from the soil.
explanation.definitionFit: An acropolis is the fortified hilltop citadel of an ancient Greek city.

clue.text: Old writer's phraseology

definitions.meaning: a stylus, the pointed instrument for writing on wax tablets, was also called by this name
manner of expression in writing or speech

explanation.surface: An old author's way with words.
explanation.definitionFit: Style means both an ancient writing implement and a manner of expression.

clue.text: Creepy-crawly makes girl take cover

parts.note: Anne is a girl's name
a lid is a cover

explanation.surface: A bug makes a girl run for shelter.
explanation.definitionFit: An annelid is a segmented worm, such as an earthworm or leech.

clue.text: Sharpness of detective inspector, initially in an urban environment

indicators.note: in places the detective's initials inside the other letters

parts.note: a city is an urban environment

indicators.note: the first letter of the word it picks from

parts.note: the initials of detective inspector are DI

explanation.surface: A police inspector shows edge in the city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' means 'by its initials', not 'first letter of', which would give only D.
explanation.definitionFit: Acidity is sourness or tartness, a sharp quality of taste or tone.

clue.text: Constant not involving fractions

explanation.surface: A steady figure with no fractions.
explanation.definitionFit: Even means steady and also a round number with no fractional part.

clue.text: Dominated by Victoria, say? Don't exaggerate!

parts.note: under means subject to, dominated by
Victoria is an example of a state, in Australia

explanation.surface: Someone ruled by Queen Victoria is told not to overdo it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Victoria' suggests the queen; it is the Australian state.
explanation.definitionFit: To understate is to play down, the opposite of exaggerating.
